clue.text: Pole writes with little hesitation, being a good writer

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for the South Pole
to pen is to write, so pens means writes
er is the short noise of a speaker hesitating

explanation.surface: A Polish author who writes with only slight hesitation is praised as a fine writer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pole' suggests a Polish person, but it is the geographical pole, S for South.
explanation.definitionFit: Edmund Spenser, poet of The Faerie Queene, is one of the great Elizabethan authors.

clue.text: A musical instrument to lay off, however!

parts.note: to sack is to dismiss from a job
but means however

explanation.surface: Someone is told to fire an instrumentalist, yet with reservations.
explanation.definitionFit: This is an early trombone used in Renaissance music.

clue.text: Walk please, and work out

indicators.note: to work out the letters is to rearrange them into a solution

explanation.surface: Someone is urged to go for a stroll and do some exercise.
explanation.walkthrough: 'work out' rearranges PLEASE and AND.
explanation.definitionFit: A promenade by the sea is a paved place for strolling.

clue.text: A flower store

definitions.meaning: a supply of goods kept for use

explanation.definitionFit: It is a fragrant garden bloom and also a supply of goods held in reserve.

clue.text: The scoundrel wants cars for patching up — a number

indicators.note: mending cars means taking them apart and putting the letters together anew

parts.note: L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: A villain needs vehicles repaired and some quantity of them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for patching up' rearranges CARS; 'a number' is A plus L, the Roman fifty.
explanation.definitionFit: A rogue or villain, someone dishonest, is a rascal.

clue.text: In colourful surroundings model appears tranquil

indicators.note: the model is placed in, that is inside, the surroundings the clue describes

parts.note: red is a colour, here wrapped round the other piece
to pose is to model for an artist

explanation.surface: A model posing against a bright backdrop looks calm.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone at rest, calm and composed, can be described as reposed.

clue.text: Roundabout way to break down a Conservative

parts.note: to rot is to decay or break down
a Tory is a member of the UK Conservative Party

explanation.surface: Here is an indirect way to bring a Conservative politician to ruin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Roundabout' looks like indirect, but means turning in circles.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that revolves on an axis, going round and round, is rotatory.

clue.text: Quiet workers. They are 16

parts.note: p is the musical abbreviation for piano, quiet
artisans are skilled craft workers

explanation.surface: Silent labourers are said to be biased.
explanation.walkthrough: 16 is ONE-SIDED: committed supporters take one side.
explanation.definitionFit: Committed supporters of a cause are biased, taking a single side.

clue.text: Drink getting left, make a song about it

indicators.note: the singing goes about, around, the letter for left

parts.note: to sing is to make a song

explanation.surface: Someone abandoned with a drink sings about it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'make a song about it' suggests making a fuss, but 'about' puts L inside SING.
explanation.definitionFit: A gin cocktail sweetened and flavoured is a well-known mixed drink.

clue.text: Individual putting in order for kitchen equipment

definitions.meaning: one who arranges or dresses, as a window or a wound
a sideboard with shelves for crockery

explanation.definitionFit: One who arranges things neatly, and a kitchen cabinet with shelves for plates.

clue.text: Rich, but caught with financial liabilities when without work

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside: the other pieces sit around the word for work

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught
IOUs are written promises to pay a debt
op is short for opus, a work

explanation.surface: Someone wealthy is nonetheless caught out by debts while unemployed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without work' reads as unemployed, but 'without' is used in its old sense of outside, so the work sits between the other pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Copious means plentiful or abundant, as a rich harvest is.

clue.text: Social crawler living in a well-organised community

definitions.text: Social crawler living in a well-organised community

parts.words: Social crawler living in a well-organised community
parts.note: a social insect that creeps about and lives in a highly ordered colony, like an ant

explanation.surface: A fawning social climber lives in a tidy, orderly neighbourhood.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Social crawler' suggests a sycophant; it is a social insect that crawls.
explanation.definitionFit: These wood-eating insects live in large colonies with strict castes of workers and soldiers.

clue.text: They're useless at target practice, never scoring a hit

definitions.text: They're useless at target practice, never scoring a hit

parts.words: They're useless at target practice, never scoring a hit
parts.note: rounds with powder but no bullet make a bang yet can never strike anything

explanation.surface: Some shooters are hopeless on the range and always miss.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests poor marksmen; the cryptic reading is ammunition that has no bullet at all.
explanation.definitionFit: Ammunition with powder but no projectile, used for noise in drills and films, cannot hit a target.

clue.text: A container of sorts, true —— an extraordinary contraption

indicators.note: an odd contrivance suggests the letters are assembled into a new form

explanation.surface: Some vessel or other is described as a truly peculiar gadget.
explanation.walkthrough: 'extraordinary contraption' rearranges TRUE and AN.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a large metal vessel with a tap, used for making and serving tea in quantity.

clue.text: The drawback about supporting 4

indicators.note: the refund goes about, around, the word for supporting

parts.note: a drawback is a refund of duty, a rebate
pro means in favour of, supporting

explanation.surface: The disadvantage concerns backing a villain.
explanation.walkthrough: 4 is RASCAL. 'drawback' looks like disadvantage, but here is a repayment of duty.
explanation.definitionFit: A rascal is a scoundrel, and a depraved, unprincipled person is too.

clue.text: A short break to seek inspiration?

definitions.text: A short break to seek inspiration?

parts.words: A short break to seek inspiration?
parts.note: a pause to rest, read as one who draws in air, inspiration in its literal sense of inhaling

explanation.surface: Someone takes a quick pause hoping for a creative idea.
explanation.walkthrough: Inspiration literally means drawing breath in, which is the hidden second sense.
explanation.definitionFit: A brief rest from effort lets you catch your breath, hence the name.

clue.text: Simple-minded as he undoubtedly is, he's health-conscious

definitions.text: Simple-minded as he undoubtedly is, he's health-conscious

parts.words: Simple-minded as he undoubtedly is, he's health-conscious
parts.note: simples are medicinal plants, so a person whose mind is on simples cares about cures

explanation.surface: A rather dim man nonetheless cares a great deal about his wellbeing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Simple-minded' seems an insult, but simples are old-fashioned herbal remedies.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who grows or sells medicinal plants deals in remedies for health.

clue.text: Biassed-and might well be so indeed!

indicators.note: suggests the letters could equally appear in some other arrangement

explanation.surface: A view is called prejudiced, and it might well be.
explanation.walkthrough: 'might well be' rearranges SO and INDEED.
explanation.definitionFit: Prejudiced in favour of one party, seeing only one view.

clue.text: All-inclusive job for a cleaner

definitions.meaning: a task done with a broom

explanation.definitionFit: A wide-ranging statement covers everything, and brushing the floor is a cleaner's chore.

clue.text: A flighty creature made out the account

parts.note: to make out something is to see it, so saw
a bill is an account to be paid

explanation.surface: An empty-headed person figured out what the invoice said.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flighty' suggests fickle, but here means able to fly.
explanation.definitionFit: A merganser, a diving duck with a serrated beak, is a flying bird.

clue.text: Larger-than-average game bird

parts.note: OS stands for outsize, a clothing size larger than average
game is hunted animals, prey

explanation.surface: A big sporting bird is shot for food.
explanation.walkthrough: 'game bird' looks like one phrase, but 'game' gives PREY and 'bird' is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: This fish-eating hawk is a familiar bird of prey.

clue.text: Admitted defeat when brought in

definitions.meaning: produced a return, as crops or an investment

explanation.definitionFit: One surrenders by giving way, and a field gives a crop: both senses mean gave.

clue.text: In Utopia tending to be hypnotic

indicators.note: the answer sits in, within, the run of letters across these two words

explanation.surface: In an ideal world things tend towards sleep.
explanation.definitionFit: A drug that dulls the senses and induces sleep is a hypnotic in the noun sense.

clue.text: A holiday resort — tame now-pressure may change that

indicators.note: the letters before this phrase are allowed to switch places into a new order

explanation.surface: A seaside town finds a tame present-day pressure could alter it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'may change' rearranges TAME NOW PRESSURE. WESTON-SUPER-MARE is an English seaside resort in Somerset.
explanation.definitionFit: This Somerset town on the Bristol Channel is a traditional British seaside destination.

clue.text: Authoritarian German star.

explanation.definitionFit: Strict and severe in manner, and the German noun for a star.

clue.text: An official note on the first lady

indicators.note: in a down clue the first piece is placed on top of the second

parts.note: re is the second note of the sol-fa scale
Eve was the first woman in the Bible

explanation.surface: A dignitary writes a memo concerning the First Lady.
explanation.walkthrough: 'first lady' suggests a president's wife; it is Eve. A reeve was a medieval English local magistrate.
explanation.definitionFit: A reeve was a local magistrate or steward in medieval England.

clue.text: Country music composer

definitions.meaning: John ..., an English composer of the 20th century

explanation.definitionFit: It is both a nation of the British Isles and the surname of English composer John Ireland.

clue.text: Person in the USA, having a good reason, retaining sovereign

indicators.note: the first piece keeps the ruler held within it

parts.note: sound reason or sanity is a sound mind
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the reigning queen

explanation.surface: An American with a sound justification is holding on to the monarch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sovereign' suggests the gold coin; here it is the reigning queen, held inside the reason.
explanation.definitionFit: An old term for a Native American person, blending American and Indian.

clue.text: This kind of oil was first seen around in the South-east

indicators.note: the first piece is shown wrapped around the letters that follow

parts.note: led means was first, at the front
SE is the compass abbreviation for South-east

explanation.surface: A particular oil was supposedly first spotted in south-east England.
explanation.walkthrough: 'seen around' is the container signal: the word for leading wraps the two short pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Oil pressed from flax seeds is used in paints and wood finishes.

clue.text: Raised and dealt with deer, etc

indicators.note: like cards being dealt, the letters are handed out again in a new order

explanation.surface: Someone bred and handled deer and other animals.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dealt with' rearranges DEER and ETC.
explanation.definitionFit: Something put up, like a building or a tent, has been raised.
